Superdraw Weekend in Australia

This Saturday marks the date for the next Australian Superdraw and lottery enthusiasts around the world are eagerly anticipating this not-to-be-missed event.

This weekend’s draw features a special SUPER-SIZED minimum jackpot guarantee. Unlike regular draws, the Australian Superdraw offers a minimum guaranteed jackpot of $20 million regardless of whether there was a carryover from the preceding draw of Australia’s Saturday Lotto.

One of the remarkable features of the Saturday Lotto in Australia is the limited pool of numbers to choose from—only 45 balls. This makes the odds of winning the Division 1 Jackpot Prize statistically easier compared to major lotteries worldwide. It’s a rare opportunity to play a 6/45 lottery with a $20 million jackpot!
